info.title: job_ready API
info.description: Hack the Change 2026. Log in with POST /api/v1/auth/login (demo@jobready.dev / demo1234) and use the token as Bearer auth. Every response is wrapped as {code, msg, data}: code 1 = success, 0 = failure (msg has the reason). All successes return HTTP 200.

post.summary: AI writes a new resume from my profile for one job (send opportunityId OR jobDescription)

get.summary: Download a resume as PDF (raw file, not wrapped in Result)

msg.example: email must be a well-formed email address
